task_completion.description: The agent generated the summary text file with the required range calculations.

task_completion.description: The GMAT script is saved to the specified output directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the GMAT graphical user interface rather than just writing a script via terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not hallucinate values; the values in the summary file correspond to the data seen in GMAT reports/plots.
integrity.visual_evidence: Consistency between GMAT's internal data displays (ReportFiles/Output tabs) and the final rpo_summary.txt.

integrity.description: The agent used GMAT's calculation capabilities (ReportFiles or Variables) to find min/max range rather than guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: The GMAT Mission tree contains commands for data output or math variables to track relative distance.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a 24-hour propagation (86400 seconds). The safety threshold is 0.5 km; if min_range_km is less than 0.5, passive_safety_violated must be 'true'. The coordinate system must be exactly 'TargetVNB'. The force model must be Two-Body (Point Mass) only.
